business_summary.text: DCW Limited makes soda ash, caustic soda, PVC, C-PVC, synthetic rutile and synthetic iron oxide pigments at plants in Dhrangadhra, Gujarat and Sahupuram, Tamil Nadu.

call_points.text: SIOP Phase I ramp-up of 7,000 MT and power plant efficiency capex planned for capitalisation in Q4-FY28.
Q2 operational income rose 22.9% YoY to ₹662.9 Cr, driven by 31.5% growth in Speciality Chemicals and 19.9% in Basic Chemicals.
Q2 EBITDA declined 18.1% YoY to ₹47.5 Cr, as Basic Chemicals EBITDA growth was offset by a 33.2% drop in Speciality Chemicals.
Speciality Chemicals faced margin pressure from contracting PVC-CPVC spreads and elevated ocean freight costs for North American exports.
Soda Ash volumes declined during the quarter due to flood-related plant disruptions.
Value-added products in the pigment category will enter the market during FY28 alongside Phase I construction.
Next growth capex is ready but held back until geopolitics settles; it will be in specialty or related chemistry.
Caustic soda realisation rose to above $400 in Q1 from about $350 in Q4 on Southeast Asian supply disruption.
Soda ash import price is about $250; imports from Iran and Russia have stopped, supporting prices.
VCM feedstock from the Middle East is paused by the conflict; replacement supply costs more and is hard to pass on in PVC.
Management would not forecast PVC prices, saying it is "anybody's guess" and too early to comment.
Synthetic rutile spread is expected to stay elevated this year on a better ex-China sales mix and long-term contracts.
Specialty Chemicals EBITDA fell 5% in FY26 with margins at 29.7% from 35.3% on a sharp fall in CPVC net realisations.
FY26 saw highest-ever sales volumes in CPVC, SIOP and Synthetic Rutile, with volumes up YoY across all product segments.
No additional term borrowings during the year; closing net debt ₹71 Cr with cash including bank FDs of ₹204 Cr.
25-30% of incremental PVC volumes are being diverted for captive consumption.

guidance.statement: FY27 finance cost to fall to ₹50 Cr or below from ₹62 Cr in FY26
Company expects to be net cash positive after ₹130 Cr of scheduled FY27 debt repayment against ₹71 Cr net debt
The total capex investment for the entire projects including both phase of SIOP is estimated to be INR 250 Cr spent over next 2-3 years.

operating_notes.text: FY26 capacity utilisation: C-PVC 102%, SIOP 98%, Caustic Soda 90%, PVC 91%, Soda Ash 86%.
Specialty Chemicals contributed 80% of FY26 segmental EBITDA on 28% of revenue; Basic Chemicals 16%.
58 MW captive co-generation power plant supports cost-effective supply; 25-30% of incremental PVC volumes diverted to captive use.
C-PVC capacity raised to 50,000 t from 20,000 t; FY26 C-PVC volumes about 37,000-38,000 t versus about 22,000 t, with the final 10,000 t benefiting from Q1FY27.
Caustic soda realisation was about $350 in Q4 and above $400 in Q1; soda ash import price is about $250.
Solar substitution saved about ₹23-24 Cr in FY26 power cost, against ₹25-30 Cr guided earlier.
Total expansion in SIOP is planned for 15,000 MT (50% capacity enhancement) in a phased manner: Phase I of 7,000 MT and Phase II of 8,000 MT.
In Q2FY27, capacity utilisations were C-PVC 111%, SIOP 83%, Caustic Soda 84%, PVC 88%, and Soda Ash 68% (down due to floods).

timeline.summary: FY26 investor presentation (consolidated): revenue ₹2,144 Cr (+7.2% YoY), PAT ₹48 Cr (+60.1%), specialty margin down to 29.7% on CPVC realisations.
DCW Limited held an earnings conference call with investors and analysts on May 6, 2026, at 02:00 PM (IST) to discuss Q4 and FY2026 performance.

DCW's Q4/FY26 earnings call (6 May 2026) reported FY26 revenue ₹2,144 Cr (+7.2%), EBITDA ₹240 Cr (+11.2%) and PAT ₹48 Cr (+60%), with net debt down to ₹71 Cr; management said the ₹400 Cr FY27 EBITDA target is derailed by price erosion.
DCW Limited announced a proposed inter-se transfer of 3.71% promoter shares between joint and single demat accounts on October 15, 2026.
Board approves ₹40 Cr buyback at ₹58 per share and Q2FY27 results.
DCW announced a ₹250 Cr capex plan over 2-3 years for a 15,000 MT SIOP pigment expansion and power plant efficiency, alongside Q2FY27 presentation.
DCW Limited held its earnings conference call with investors/analysts on Friday, October 30, 2026 at 02:00 P.M. (1ST).
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹662.86 Cr, net profit ₹10.36 Cr (-25.0% YoY).
